text_en: The word that the Lord spoke concerning Babylon, concerning the land of the Chaldeans, by the prophet Jeremiah:
text_cn: 关于巴比伦和加色丁地上主藉耶肋米亚先知所说的话：

text_en: Declare among the nations and proclaim, set up a banner and proclaim, do not conceal it, say: Babylon is taken, Bel is put to shame, Merodach is dismayed. Her images are put to shame, her idols are dismayed.
text_cn: 你们该在民族间宣布传扬，该树起旗帜传扬，不该隐瞒，说：“巴比伦已陷落了，贝耳遭受了羞辱，默洛达客倾倒了；她的偶像遭受了耻辱，她的神祇倾倒了。”

text_en: For out of the north a nation has come up against her; it shall make her land a desolation, and no one shall live in it; both human beings and animals shall flee away.
text_cn: 因为有一民族从北方上来，向她进攻，使她的国土化为无人居住，人兽绝迹的荒野。

text_en: In those days and in that time, says the Lord , the people of Israel shall come, they and the people of Judah together; they shall come weeping as they seek the Lord their God.
text_cn: 在那些日子里和在那时期中──上主的断语──以色列子民要与犹大子民一同归来，且走且哭，寻觅上主他们的天主，

text_en: They shall ask the way to Zion, with faces turned toward it, and they shall come and join themselves to the Lord by an everlasting covenant that will never be forgotten.
text_cn: 他们必询问熙雍的所在，面朝往那里的道路说：“来，让我们以永久不可忘的盟约依附上主！”

text_en: My people have been lost sheep; their shepherds have led them astray, turning them away on the mountains; from mountain to hill they have gone, they have forgotten their fold.
text_cn: 我的人民是一群迷途的羊群，他们的牧人使他们流浪，在群山间徘徊，翻山越岭地漫游，忘掉了自己的羊栈。

text_en: All who found them have devoured them, and their enemies have said, “We are not guilty, because they have sinned against the Lord , the true pasture, the Lord , the hope of their ancestors. ”
text_cn: 凡遇见他们的，就将他们吞噬；他们的仇敌反而说：“我们并没有过错，因为是他们得罪了上主，正义的渊源和他们祖先的希望。”

text_en: Flee from Babylon, and go out of the land of the Chaldeans, and be like male goats leading the flock.
text_cn: 你们该逃离巴比伦，走出加色丁地，如同羊群前领头的公山羊。

text_en: For I am going to stir up and bring against Babylon a company of great nations from the land of the north; and they shall array themselves against her; from there she shall be taken. Their arrows are like the arrows of a skilled warrior who does not return empty-handed.
text_cn: 因为，看，我必从北方，发动一群强盛的民族前来进攻巴比伦，列阵向她进攻，就地将她攻陷；他们的箭像是善战的勇士，从不空手而归。

text_en: Chaldea shall be plundered; all who plunder her shall be sated, says the Lord .
text_cn: 加色丁必遭劫掠，凡劫掠她的，必心满意足──上主的断语。

text_en: Though you rejoice, though you exult, O plunderers of my heritage, though you frisk about like a heifer on the grass, and neigh like stallions,
text_cn: 你们抢夺我产业的人，你们尽管喜乐，尽管欢欣：跳跃，好像踏青的小公牛；嘶鸣，有如获偶的牡马！

text_en: your mother shall be utterly shamed, and she who bore you shall be disgraced. Lo, she shall be the last of the nations, a wilderness, dry land, and a desert.
text_cn: 你们的母亲已遭受极大的耻辱，生养你的，已满面羞惭。看，她已成为民族中最卑下的，成了旷野、旱地和荒原；

text_en: Because of the wrath of the Lord she shall not be inhabited, but shall be an utter desolation; everyone who passes by Babylon shall be appalled and hiss because of all her wounds.
text_cn: 在上主的盛怒下，她已无人居住，满目凄凉：凡经过巴比伦的人，看见她的种种惨状，莫不惊异嗟叹。

text_en: Take up your positions around Babylon, all you that bend the bow; shoot at her, spare no arrows, for she has sinned against the Lord .
text_cn: 一切开张弓弩的射手！你们应列阵围攻巴比伦，向她射击，不要吝惜箭羽，因为她得罪了上主。

text_en: Raise a shout against her from all sides, “She has surrendered; her bulwarks have fallen, her walls are thrown down. ” For this is the vengeance of the Lord : take vengeance on her, do to her as she has done.
text_cn: 你们四周围绕，向她呐喊！她必伸手请降，她的城楼必将陷落，她的城墙必要被攻陷，因为这是上主的报复。你们报复她，照她作的还报！

text_en: Cut off from Babylon the sower, and the wielder of the sickle in time of harvest; because of the destroying sword all of them shall return to their own people, and all of them shall flee to their own land.
text_cn: 你们要歼灭巴比伦播种和手持镰刀收割的人！面临无情的刀剑，各人回归自己的民族，各自逃往自己的故乡。

text_en: Israel is a hunted sheep driven away by lions. First the king of Assyria devoured it, and now at the end King Nebuchadrezzar of Babylon has gnawed its bones.
text_cn: 以色列是狮子追捕的亡羊，首先吞噬她的，是亚述君王；最后咬碎她骨骸的，是拿步高巴比伦王。

text_en: Therefore, thus says the Lord of hosts, the God of Israel: I am going to punish the king of Babylon and his land, as I punished the king of Assyria.
text_cn: 为此，万军的上主，以色列的天主这样说：“看，我要惩罚巴比伦王和他的国土，就如我惩罚了亚述君王一样。

text_en: I will restore Israel to its pasture, and it shall feed on Carmel and in Bashan, and on the hills of Ephraim and in Gilead its hunger shall be satisfied.
text_cn: 我要领以色列回归自己的牧场，在加尔默耳和巴商牧放，使他们的心灵在厄弗辣因与基肋阿得山上，获得满足。

text_en: In those days and at that time, says the Lord , the iniquity of Israel shall be sought, and there shall be none; and the sins of Judah, and none shall be found; for I will pardon the remnant that I have spared.
text_cn: 在那些日子里和在那时期中──上主的断语──要想寻求以色列的不义，却一无所有；要想寻求犹大的罪恶，却一无所见；因为我必宽恕我留下的遗民。

text_en: Go up to the land of Merathaim; go up against her, and attack the inhabitants of Pekod and utterly destroy the last of them, says the Lord ; do all that I have commanded you.
text_cn: 你们该向默辣塔因地推进，进攻培科得的居民，屠杀，彻底将他们消灭──上主的断语──全照我吩咐的进行。

text_en: The noise of battle is in the land, and great destruction!
text_cn: 地上发生了交战的呐喊，巨大的毁灭。

text_en: How the hammer of the whole earth is cut down and broken! How Babylon has become a horror among the nations!
text_cn: 怎么，威震全地的锤子也被破碎毁坏了？怎么，巴比伦在万民中也变得如此凄凉？

text_en: You set a snare for yourself and you were caught, O Babylon, but you did not know it; you were discovered and seized, because you challenged the Lord .
text_cn: 我给你布下罗网，你竟被捉住；而你，巴比伦，尚不自觉；你被寻获，且被捉住，因为你竟敢违抗上主！”

text_en: The Lord has opened his armory, and brought out the weapons of his wrath, for the Lord God of hosts has a task to do in the land of the Chaldeans.
text_cn: 上主开了自己的武库，搬出了自己泄怒的武器，因为吾主万军的上主，在加色丁地有事要完成。

text_en: Come against her from every quarter; open her granaries; pile her up like heaps of grain, and destroy her utterly; let nothing be left of her.
text_cn: 你们从四面八方向她涌来，打开她的仓库，堆积成堆，彻底消灭，不给她留下残余；

text_en: Kill all her bulls, let them go down to the slaughter. Alas for them, their day has come, the time of their punishment!
text_cn: 屠杀她的一切公牛，叫他们下入屠场！他们的灾难临头，因为他们的日子到了，到了惩罚他们的时候。

text_en: Listen! Fugitives and refugees from the land of Babylon are coming to declare in Zion the vengeance of the Lord our God, vengeance for his temple.
text_cn: 听，从巴比伦地逃命出走的人，在熙雍报告说：“上主我们的天主在复仇，为自己的殿宇雪耻。

text_en: Summon archers against Babylon, all who bend the bow. Encamp all around her; let no one escape. Repay her according to her deeds; just as she has done, do to her—for she has arrogantly defied the Lord , the Holy One of Israel.
text_cn: 你们召集弓手，一切挽弓的人，来向巴比伦进攻，在她周围扎营，不要让她有人逃脱，该按照她的作为而报复她，照她所作的对待她，因为她傲慢反对上主，反对以色列的圣者。

text_en: Therefore her young men shall fall in her squares, and all her soldiers shall be destroyed on that day, says the Lord .
text_cn: 为此，她的青年人要倒毙在她的广场，她所有的战士都要在那一天内灭亡──上主的断语──

text_en: I am against you, O arrogant one, says the Lord God of hosts; for your day has come, the time when I will punish you.
text_cn: 你这骄横的人！看，我来对付你──我主万军上主的断语──因为你的日子到了，到了惩罚你的时候。

text_en: The arrogant one shall stumble and fall, with no one to raise him up, and I will kindle a fire in his cities, and it will devour everything around him.
text_cn: 骄横的必要倾覆颠仆，再没有人来使她复兴；我必放火烧毁她的城市，火要吞灭她四周的一切。”

text_en: Thus says the Lord of hosts: The people of Israel are oppressed, and so too are the people of Judah; all their captors have held them fast and refuse to let them go.
text_cn: 万军的上主这样说：“以色列子民与犹大子民一同遭受了压迫；凡俘掳他们的，都扣留他们，不肯释放。”

text_en: Their Redeemer is strong; the Lord of hosts is his name. He will surely plead their cause, that he may give rest to the earth, but unrest to the inhabitants of Babylon.
text_cn: 但是，他们的救赎者，名叫万军的上主，刚强有力，必要辩护他们的案件，使大地安宁，使巴比伦的居民惶乱。

text_en: A sword against the Chaldeans, says the Lord , and against the inhabitants of Babylon, and against her officials and her sages!
text_cn: 刀剑加于加色丁人──上主的断语──加于巴比伦的居民，她的公卿和她的谋臣；

text_en: A sword against the diviners, so that they may become fools! A sword against her warriors, so that they may be destroyed!
text_cn: 刀剑加于她的巫士，使他们疯狂；刀剑加于她的勇士，叫他们惊慌；

text_en: A sword against her horses and against her chariots, and against all the foreign troops in her midst, so that they may become women! A sword against all her treasures, that they may be plundered!
text_cn: 刀剑加于她的战马战车，加于她境内所有的杂族，使他们柔弱如妇女；刀剑加于她的府库，使人任意抢夺；

text_en: A drought against her waters, that they may be dried up! For it is a land of images, and they go mad over idols.
text_cn: 刀剑加于她的水源，叫水源涸(hé)竭(jié)，因为她偶像遍地，人们痴恋这些怪物；

text_en: Therefore wild animals shall live with hyenas in Babylon, and ostriches shall inhabit her; she shall never again be peopled, or inhabited for all generations.
text_cn: 为此，她必成为野猫和野狗的巢穴，鸵鸟的栖身地，永远不会有人居住，世世代代不会有居民；

text_en: As when God overthrew Sodom and Gomorrah and their neighbors, says the Lord , so no one shall live there, nor shall anyone settle in her.
text_cn: 恰如天主灭亡了的索多玛、哈摩辣及附近的城市一样──上主的断语──再没有人居住，再没有人留宿。

text_en: Look, a people is coming from the north; a mighty nation and many kings are stirring from the farthest parts of the earth.
text_cn: 看，有一个民族，从北方来，有一个强盛的异邦和许多君王从地极兴起，

text_en: They wield bow and spear, they are cruel and have no mercy. The sound of them is like the roaring sea; they ride upon horses, set in array as a warrior for battle, against you, O daughter Babylon!
text_cn: 紧握弓矛，残忍无情，像海啸般喧嚷，骑着战马，万众一心，严阵准备向你进攻，巴比伦女郎！

text_en: The king of Babylon heard news of them, and his hands fell helpless; anguish seized him, pain like that of a woman in labor.
text_cn: 巴比伦王听到了他们前来的消息，束手无策，不胜忧虑，痛苦得有如临盆的产妇。

text_en: Like a lion coming up from the thickets of the Jordan against a perennial pasture, I will suddenly chase them away from her; and I will appoint over her whomever I choose. For who is like me? Who can summon me? Who is the shepherd who can stand before me?
text_cn: 看哪，好像一只雄狮，从约但的丛林上来，走向常绿的牧场；同样，我也要转瞬间将他们赶走，派我选定的人来统治。诚然，谁是我的对手？谁敢向我提出质问？谁能对抗我的牧人？

text_en: Therefore hear the plan that the Lord has made against Babylon, and the purposes that he has formed against the land of the Chaldeans: Surely the little ones of the flock shall be dragged away; surely their fold shall be appalled at their fate.
text_cn: 为此，请你们听上主对巴比伦设下的计谋，对加色丁地策划的策略：连最弱小的羊也一定要被人牵去， 他们的牧场也必对他们战栗。

text_en: At the sound of the capture of Babylon the earth shall tremble, and her cry shall be heard among the nations.
text_cn: 巴比伦轰然陷落，大地为之震动；哀号之声，直达万邦。
